workflow.name: VirusTotal IOC enrichment
workflow.description: On IOC creation or update, looks the IOC (hash, IP, domain or URL) up on VirusTotal, stores the verdict and a readable summary (detection ratio, threat label and names, flagging engines, reputation, dates, network or registrar) in the IOC enrichment ("virustotal" key) and a vt:<verdict> tag, and notifies the case owner and whoever added the IOC when it is malicious. Needs the keystore entry VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY (restrict it to www.virustotal.com). Each IOC value is looked up at most once a day.

config.code:
# Verdict of the VirusTotal answer, merged into the IOC enrichment and tags
THRESHOLD = 3  # engines flagging the IOC as malicious before the analysts are alerted

ioc = inputs['ioc'] if is_dict(inputs['ioc']) else {}
target = inputs['target']
response = inputs['response'] if is_dict(inputs['response']) else {}
body = response.get('body') if is_dict(response.get('body')) else {}
item = body.get('data') if is_dict(body.get('data')) else {}
attributes = item.get('attributes') if is_dict(item.get('attributes')) else {}


def as_dict(value):
    return value if is_dict(value) else {}


def as_list(value):
    return value if is_list(value) else []


def count(value):
    return int(value) if is_number(value) else 0


stats = as_dict(attributes.get('last_analysis_stats'))
results = as_dict(attributes.get('last_analysis_results'))
found = response.get('status_code') == 200 and bool(attributes)
malicious = count(stats.get('malicious'))
suspicious = count(stats.get('suspicious'))
harmless = count(stats.get('harmless'))
undetected = count(stats.get('undetected'))
# Engines that gave an opinion: not those which timed out, failed or do not handle the type
engines = sum([count(n) for k, n in stats.items() if k not in ('timeout', 'failure', 'type-unsupported')])
if not found:
    verdict = 'unknown'
elif malicious >= THRESHOLD:
    verdict = 'malicious'
elif malicious > 0 or suspicious > 0:
    verdict = 'suspicious'
else:
    verdict = 'clean'

link = f"https://www.virustotal.com/gui/{target['gui']}/{item.get('id') or target['id']}" if found else None
flagged = sorted([[engine, outcome.get('category'), outcome.get('result') or outcome.get('category')]
                  for engine, outcome in results.items()
                  if is_dict(outcome) and outcome.get('category') in ('malicious', 'suspicious')],
                 key=lambda row: (row[1] != 'malicious', row[0].lower()))
detections = [f'{row[0]}: {row[2]}' for row in flagged][:25]

classification = as_dict(attributes.get('popular_threat_classification'))
threat_label = classification.get('suggested_threat_label')


def popular(entries):
    # [{value, count}] of the classification, most cited first
    rows = [e for e in as_list(entries) if is_dict(e) and e.get('value')]
    return [str(e.get('value')) for e in sorted(rows, key=lambda e: -count(e.get('count')))][:5]


threat_categories = popular(classification.get('popular_threat_category'))
threat_names = popular(classification.get('popular_threat_name'))
names = [str(n) for n in as_list(attributes.get('names')) if n][:10]
meaningful_name = attributes.get('meaningful_name')
if meaningful_name and meaningful_name not in names:
    names = [meaningful_name] + names[:9]
votes = as_dict(attributes.get('total_votes'))
categories = sorted(set([str(v) for v in as_dict(attributes.get('categories')).values()]))[:10]
sandboxes = sorted(set([str(v.get('category')) for v in as_dict(attributes.get('sandbox_verdicts')).values()
                        if is_dict(v) and v.get('category') in ('malicious', 'suspicious')]))
yara = [str(r.get('rule_name')) for r in as_list(attributes.get('crowdsourced_yara_results'))
        if is_dict(r) and r.get('rule_name')][:10]

virustotal = {
    'value': target['value'],
    'checked_at': inputs['now'],
    'found': found,
    'verdict': verdict,
    'link': link,
    'detection_ratio': f'{malicious}/{engines}' if found else None,
    'detection_percent': round(100 * malicious / engines, 1) if engines else 0,
    'malicious': malicious,
    'suspicious': suspicious,
    'harmless': harmless,
    'undetected': undetected,
    'engines': engines,
    'detections': detections,
    'flagged_by': [row[0] for row in flagged if row[1] == 'malicious'][:25],
}
optional = {
    'threat_label': threat_label,
    'threat_categories': threat_categories,
    'threat_names': threat_names,
    'meaningful_name': meaningful_name,
    'names': names,
    'reputation': attributes.get('reputation'),
    'community_votes': {'harmless': count(votes.get('harmless')), 'malicious': count(votes.get('malicious'))}
    if votes else None,
    'type_description': attributes.get('type_description'),
    'type_tags': as_list(attributes.get('type_tags'))[:10],
    'size': attributes.get('size'),
    'md5': attributes.get('md5'),
    'sha1': attributes.get('sha1'),
    'sha256': attributes.get('sha256'),
    'times_submitted': attributes.get('times_submitted'),
    'first_seen': iso_datetime(attributes.get('first_submission_date')),
    'last_analysed': iso_datetime(attributes.get('last_analysis_date')),
    'country': attributes.get('country'),
    'continent': attributes.get('continent'),
    'as_owner': attributes.get('as_owner'),
    'asn': attributes.get('asn'),
    'network': attributes.get('network'),
    'registrar': attributes.get('registrar'),
    'domain_created': iso_datetime(attributes.get('creation_date')),
    'categories': categories,
    'final_url': attributes.get('last_final_url'),
    'page_title': attributes.get('title'),
    'http_code': attributes.get('last_http_response_code'),
    'sandbox_verdicts': sandboxes,
    'yara_rules': yara,
    'tags': as_list(attributes.get('tags'))[:20],
}
for name, value in optional.items():
    if value not in (None, '', [], {}):
        virustotal[name] = value

# One readable paragraph: the notification body and the first thing to read in the enrichment
if not found:
    summary = 'Unknown to VirusTotal.'
else:
    parts = [f'{verdict.capitalize()}: {malicious}/{engines} engines flag it as malicious'
             + (f', {suspicious} as suspicious' if suspicious else '') + '.']
    if threat_label:
        parts.append(f'Threat label: {threat_label}.')
    if threat_categories or threat_names:
        parts.append('Classified as ' + ', '.join(threat_categories + threat_names) + '.')
    if names:
        parts.append('Known as ' + ', '.join(names[:5]) + '.')
    if virustotal.get('flagged_by'):
        flagged_by = virustotal['flagged_by']
        more = f' and {len(flagged_by) - 5} more' if len(flagged_by) > 5 else ''
        parts.append('Flagged by ' + ', '.join(flagged_by[:5]) + more + '.')
    if virustotal.get('type_description'):
        parts.append(f"Type: {virustotal['type_description']}.")
    if virustotal.get('as_owner') or virustotal.get('country'):
        where = ', '.join([str(v) for v in (virustotal.get('as_owner'), virustotal.get('country')) if v])
        parts.append(f'Network: {where}.')
    if virustotal.get('registrar'):
        parts.append(f"Registrar: {virustotal['registrar']}.")
    if virustotal.get('reputation') is not None:
        parts.append(f"Reputation: {virustotal['reputation']}.")
    if virustotal.get('first_seen'):
        parts.append(f"First seen {virustotal['first_seen'][:10]}.")
    if virustotal.get('last_analysed'):
        parts.append(f"Last analysed {virustotal['last_analysed'][:10]}.")
    summary = ' '.join(parts)
virustotal['summary'] = summary

# Keep what other sources wrote; replace the previous VirusTotal entry and vt: tag
enrichment = dict(ioc.get('ioc_enrichment')) if is_dict(ioc.get('ioc_enrichment')) else {}
enrichment['virustotal'] = virustotal
tags = [t.strip() for t in str(ioc.get('ioc_tags') or '').split(',') if t.strip()]
tags = [t for t in tags if not t.lower().startswith('vt:')] + [f'vt:{verdict}']

result = {
    'enrichment': enrichment,
    'tags': ','.join(tags),
    'verdict': verdict,
    'summary': summary,
    'detection_ratio': virustotal['detection_ratio'],
    'threat_label': threat_label,
    'names': names,
    'malicious': malicious,
    'engines': engines,
    'link': link,
    'alert': verdict == 'malicious',
}
